joint_bilateral — 3D depth_denoise op

• Data kinds: depth × image2d → depth

• Call: import depth_bilateral; depth_bilateral.joint_bilateral(depth: 'np.ndarray', guide: 'np.ndarray', spatial_sigma: 'float', range_sigma: 'float', *, invalid: 'float | None' = 0.0, truncate: 'float' = 3.0) -> 'np.ndarray' (or ops3d.get("joint_bilateral"))

Usage

Joint / cross bilateral: the depth is what gets smoothed, while the range weights come from the differences in the guide. → float64 (H,W).
